name: CLNeRF Architecture with Embeddings
definition: An architecture modification to a base NeRF model (NGP or vanilla NeRF) that uses trainable embeddings to incorporate scene changes (appearance and geometry) over time within a single model, preventing model size growth.
summary: CLNeRF is a NeRF architecture enabling continual learning by using explicit per-scan appearance and geometry embeddings to handle scene changes without model size growth.
